sloka: यस्मात्त्वं भोजनं राजन्ममैतद्दातुमिच्छसि ।तस्माद्भोजनमेतत्ते भविष्यति न संशयः ।। ७.६५.२८ ॥
transliteration: yasmāttvaṁ bhojanaṁ rājanmamaitaddātumicchasi ।tasmādbhojanametatte bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.65.28 ॥

translations.english: "Because you desire to give me this food, O king, therefore this very food shall be yours, without a doubt," (Vasistha cursed).
